import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem quadratic_sublevel_iff_abs_radius (x : ℝ) : x ^ 2 - 5 * x - 4 ≤ 10 ↔ |2 * x - 5| ≤ 9 := by
  have h_main : x ^ 2 - 5 * x - 4 ≤ 10 ↔ |2 * x - 5| ≤ 9 := by
    constructor
    · 
      intro h
      have h₁ : |2 * x - 5| ≤ 9 := by
        rw [abs_le]
        constructor <;>
        (try norm_num) <;>
        (try nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x - 5 / 2), sq_nonneg (x + 5 / 2)]) <;>
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x - 5 / 2), sq_nonneg (x + 5 / 2)]
      exact h₁
    · 
      intro h
      have h₁ : x ^ 2 - 5 * x - 4 ≤ 10 := by
        cases' abs_cases (2 * x - 5) with h₂ h₂ <;>
        (try norm_num at h ⊢) <;>
        (try nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x - 5 / 2), sq_nonneg (x + 5 / 2)]) <;>
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x - 5 / 2), sq_nonneg (x + 5 / 2)]
      exact h₁
  exact h_main

set_option autoImplicit false

theorem quadratic_sublevel_iff_abs_radius (x : ℝ) : x ^ 2 - 5 * x - 4 ≤ 10 ↔ |2 * x - 5| ≤ 9 := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    apply abs_le.mpr
    constructor
    · by_contra hn
      have hlt : 2 * x - 5 < -9 := lt_of_not_ge hn
      have hp :
          0 < (2 * x - 5 + 9) * ((2 * x - 5) - 9) := by
        apply mul_pos_of_neg_of_neg
        · linarith
        · linarith
      nlinarith
    · by_contra hn
      have hgt : 9 < 2 * x - 5 := lt_of_not_ge hn
      have hp :
          0 < (2 * x - 5 + 9) * ((2 * x - 5) - 9) := by
        apply mul_pos
        · linarith
        · linarith
      nlinarith
  · intro h
    rcases abs_le.mp h with ⟨hl, hu⟩
    have hp :
        0 ≤ (2 * x - 5 + 9) * (9 - (2 * x - 5)) := by
      apply mul_nonneg
      · linarith
      · linarith
    nlinarith

theorem quadratic_sublevel_iff_abs_radius (x : ℝ) : x ^ 2 - 5 * x - 4 ≤ 10 ↔ |2 * x - 5| ≤ 9 := by

      have hx : x < -2 := lt_of_not_ge hn

      nlinarith

set_option autoImplicit false

theorem quadratic_sublevel_iff_abs_radius (x : ℝ) : x ^ 2 - 5 * x - 4 ≤ 10 ↔ |2 * x - 5| ≤ 9 := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hlow : -9 ≤ 2 * x - 5 := by
      by_contra hn
      have hx1 : x + 2 < 0 := by
        linarith
      have hx2 : x - 7 < 0 := by
        linarith
      have hp : 0 < (x + 2) * (x - 7) :=
        mul_pos_of_neg_of_neg hx1 hx2
      nlinarith
    have hupp : 2 * x - 5 ≤ 9 := by
      by_contra hn
      have hx1 : 0 < x + 2 := by
        linarith
      have hx2 : 0 < x - 7 := by
        linarith
      have hp : 0 < (x + 2) * (x - 7) :=
        mul_pos hx1 hx2
      nlinarith
    exact abs_le.mpr ⟨hlow, hupp⟩
  · intro h
    have hb := abs_le.mp h
    have hx1 : 0 ≤ x + 2 := by
      linarith [hb.1]
    have hx2 : x - 7 ≤ 0 := by
      linarith [hb.2]
    have hp : (x + 2) * (x - 7) ≤ 0 :=
      mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos hx1 hx2
    nlinarith
